messages:
Sam: Morning — quick flight-deck standup. TL;DR: spec ready for signoff, need two CRs, small QA matrix still open.
Tess: What I did: updated the rollout doc, added fallback policy for low-capacity zones. Blocker: waiting on infra quota confirmation for dedicated pools. Today: chase infra + finish one CR.
Jordan: What I did: landed perf testing harness for long-context models, found a 12% latency spike at 2k tokens that looks batching-related. Blocker: reproing on dedicated staging. Today: dig into batching config and try smaller batch sizes.
Maya: What I did: spec pass — clarified schema for structured outputs and tool-calling. Ready for product signoff. Blocker: need ace from @Sam on the error-surface wording. Today: pair with Sam for final wording.
Sam: @Maya will review at 10:30 PT, happy to sign off after that. For the latency spike: @Jordan can you paste the minimal repro?
Jordan: repro snippet: ```bash
python run_perf.py --model redwood-v2-8b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --profile
```
Jordan: also seeing KV cache thrash when we drop to batch=2, so might be a runtime kernel switch.
Olivia: QA update: test matrix updated in drive: https://drive.company/launch/flightdeck-qamatrix — flagged input permutations 3,5,9 as flaky. I'm scheduling one focused pass tomorrow.
Tess: infra reply: quota request for dedicated pool approved but will take 48 hrs to provision. That affects our canary window if signoff is delayed.
Sam: Proposal: shift canary to Fri morning to give infra + QA time, keep soft cutoff Thu EOD. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maya: OK with Fri canary. That gives PM time to update rollout notes.
Jordan: FYI I can mitigate the perf spike by forcing continuous batching on that branch — tests show latency drop ~8%. I'll open PR with config toggle.
Olivia: Two quick asks for reviewers: 1) check the fallback wording in spec, 2) please review the regression test added for permutations 5/9. Pinged in PR #412.
Sam: CRs needed: @Tess on infra doc, @Jordan on spec change, @Maya final wording. If we get those by EOD Thu we keep Fri canary.
Tess: I'll review PR #412 this afternoon.
Jordan: Opening PR for batching toggle now. link: https://git.company/r/redwood/inference/pulls/728
deploy-bot: NOTE: staging cluster snapshot at 1768209000 restored — please rebase if you rely on latest images.
Olivia: Small logistics: can we converge on a 30-minute dry-run Thurs 4pm PT for smoke playbook? I'll set calendar for those on the invite list.
Sam: Sounds good. If anyone hits a hard blocker ping #eng-oncall so we don't miss SLAs. :thumbsup:
Maya: signing off for now, will be online at 10:30 PT for the pair.
Sam: Thanks — wrapping. I'll update the rollout doc with new canary date and assign final tasks.
